interface.shortDescription: Full-stack engineering with implementation-first visual design and machine actions
interface.longDescription: Veteran Full-Stack Engineer owns repository-wide engineering and web-first machine execution. Frontend Design Builder owns implementation-first Visual Design Authority plus a provider-neutral Design Action Fabric: concepts guide direction but never substitute for the real product. Substantial existing-product UI must survive an early code-native runtime render, reject generic or skin-only redesigns, and be visually verified through the actual implementation path before handoff.
defaultPrompt: Take ownership of this software task end to end, using the frontend design specialist whenever visual UI quality or design-system work is material.
Audit this product across engineering and UI quality, implement the highest-value fixes, and verify the real runtime result.
Build this feature as a production-quality vertical slice, including polished frontend behavior and rendered QA when applicable.
